question: Should CodexBar accept ZoomMate as a supported provider and endorse this opt-in browser-cookie-to-short-lived-bearer authentication boundary?
rationale: The implementation can be reviewed mechanically, but only repository product ownership can decide whether an enterprise AI-agent credit product and its session-credential support burden fit the provider catalog.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in provider boundary
options.body: Accept ZoomMate as a supported provider with Chrome-only import, fixed Zoom hosts, and in-memory bearer reuse as implemented.

options.title: Pause the integration
options.body: Decline or defer the provider until the product catalog or credential-boundary policy explicitly covers ZoomMate.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the opt-in provider boundary
recommendation.body: Accept ZoomMate as a supported provider with Chrome-only import, fixed Zoom hosts, and in-memory bearer reuse as implemented.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a provider-catalog and credential-boundary decision for the repository owner.
